steps.code:
import re

# Extract temperature readings from transcript
transcript = "Sensor log for bay 3. Recorded at the start of the shift. All readings are in degrees Celsius. Reading 1. 21.4. Reading 2. 19.8. Reading 3. 22.6. Reading 4. 20.2. Reading 5. 18.9. End of log."

# Find all numbers that look like temperature readings (decimal numbers)
# The pattern: "Reading X. Y." where Y is the temperature
pattern = r'Reading \d+\.\s*(\d+\.\d+)'
matches = re.findall(pattern, transcript)
temperatures = [float(match) for match in matches]
print("Extracted temperatures:", temperatures)
print("Count:", len(temperatures))
